ns2:course.label: Membership in a DRI Research Team Project
ns2:course.description: Design research is fundamentally interdisciplinary, often involving domain and process experts from a variety of fields. Students will choose to join one among several continuing peer- or faculty-led design research projects at various stages of completion. They will learn how to adapt their existing expertise to contribute productively to the project in its current stage, absorb insight from work completed at earlier stages, and collaborate with team members to advance the project toward its defined goals. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. May be repeated to a maximum of 8 hours. Prerequisite: Restricted to students enrolled in the MFA or PhD program in Design for Responsible Innovation or consent of instructor.
